name: Livewire Design System
description: Brand foundations and Email Marketing Best Practices framework for Livewire, a high-end home lighting and control integrator. Source of truth for Claude Code projects.

display.notes: Display and editorial headlines. Use italic + lighter weight for accent words.

body.notes: Body, UI, labels. Never substitute Inter/Roboto/Arial.

mono.notes: Numeric tokens, hex values, blueprint indices, specs only.

700.use: text-safe: orange text/links on light backgrounds (WCAG AA safe)

livewireOrange.use: Email brand orange: buttons, eyebrows on dark. Passes AAA on dark, FAILS on light.

color.accentRule: #F7941D on light backgrounds fails contrast. Always use #A85200 for orange text/links on white or cream. On dark, use #F7941D freely.

deepBlack.use: Hero blocks, deepest footer. Highest contrast, display headlines.

deepCharcoal.use: Final CTA close. Slight lift off deep black for rhythm.

charcoal.use: Nav bar, navigator, feature blocks. Main dark.

warmCream.use: Newsletter body. Default for Henry-voiced newsletters (April 2026+).

warmGrey.use: Trust strip & FAQ. Light without pure-white glare.

pureWhite.use: Specifier body; inline CTA cards inside cream sections.

emailSystem.creamVsWhite: Cream = newsletters / consumer / warm editorial. White = specifier / conquest / corporate (and inline CTA cards on cream). Avoid pure white for newsletters unless called for.

horizontalWhite.use: Correct for dark nav bars and footers.

logos.rule: The swoosh-only mark is never a substitute for the wordmark in email nav bars.

voiceAndAesthetic.aesthetic: Dark editorial surfaces, warm cream for consumer-facing content, copper accent used sparingly.
always: Specific over vague ('421 reviews at 4.9 stars', not 'highly rated').
Bold one key phrase per section for scanners.
End the letter with a direct invitation, not a soft close.
Use 'we' throughout: a team, not a company.
Frame offers as client benefits ('A note for your next client conversation').
never: Exclamation points in body copy (social only).
Vague superlatives: innovative, cutting-edge, world-class, best-in-class.
Fear-based language ('don't get left behind', 'before it's too late').
Standalone corporate nouns: solutions, synergy, seamless (without specifics).
Emojis in subject lines or body (social only).

subjectLines.length: 30-40 characters (6-8 words); over 50 clipped on mobile (60%+ of list opens on mobile)
subjectLines.framework: Every subject must satisfy at least 3 of 5 criteria
criteria: Opens a question/loop the reader wants to close.
Speaks to a specific felt experience, not a feature.
Could plausibly be from a trusted neighbor/peer, not a brand.
Pairs with a preheader that extends, not repeats.

approvedPatterns.skepticismHook: They came in skeptical. Watch what happened.
approvedPatterns.problemFirst: Your home looks finished. Why doesn't it feel finished?
approvedPatterns.curiosityGap: The one thing most finished homes are missing
approvedPatterns.seasonalInvitation: Spring is here. Come outside with us.

hardRules: The subject never carries both the what and the why; use the preheader to extend.
subjectLines.preheader: The second subject line: extend, never repeat. 85-100 characters ideal.
subjectLines.personalization: Personalization tokens lift opens 5-10% with clean list data.

rules: Specifier promos: hero image with baked-in text. Newsletters: display-first typographic hero.
Lead with content, never a logo banner + white space.
Specifier trust signal = product experience. Newsletter trust signal = Henry's name/face.
Short card-based table of contents right after the hero; cards link to anchors below.
Each card: numbered index (01, 02), short eyebrow label, serif headline, one-sentence description. Tappable.
Play button baked into the JPG via Python/Pillow; CSS position:absolute overlays break in Outlook/Gmail.
Place immediately after hero, same dark background, before first CTA.
Never reference the same video in both the baked image and the copy.
Two videos: Video 1 is the primary thumbnail; Video 2 is a text link or dropped.
Single-primary-CTA emails outperform multi-CTA by up to 371% CTR.
Primary CTA appears 3+ times: top/early, mid, bottom.
Copy = action + outcome ('Reserve Your Visit' over 'Book Now'/'Learn More').
Microcopy below CTA reduces anxiety ('Free. No signup. Takes about a minute.').
Inline CTA cards for secondary/within-story CTAs; full-width reserved for the top conversion action.
Offers/credits go just before booking options, not at the end.

email.faq: FAQ accordions do NOT work in email; clients strip the JS. Always show answers inline as plain Q/A. No fake + icons.
email.offers: Frame as client benefits, not hooks. Plain declarative language. No countdown/urgency/exclamation for professional audiences. Place offer inside the dark booking section, between heading and Option A.

socialProof.trustStrip: 20+ years · 4.9 stars / 421 reviews · 80% referrals · Lutron Certified
socialProof.placement: Early, right after the first CTA block.
socialProof.notes: Review counts + ratings lift click-to-consult 15-25% in home services. Named technicians are unusually powerful for Livewire.

standardNewsletter.use: Default for monthly Henry-voiced sends (updated April 2026)

blocks.purpose: Logo left, issue badge right. 16px padding.
Eyebrow + 'From Henry Clifford', display serif 44px. Text only, no photo.
2-3 tappable cards linking to stories below.
Henry's letter, short paragraphs. Primary visual here.
White rounded card, headline + button + microcopy.
Second story with its own image and primary CTA.
Same three stats every time.
4-6 plain Q/A. No fake accordion icons.
Logo + social only. Zoho auto-appends compliance block.

specifierPartner.use: Specifier / Partner sends (Ketra Experience Center build, April 2026)

blocks.purpose: Logo left, campaign badge right.
Flat JPG: room photo + gradient + headline + CTA baked via Pillow.
Bridge copy. Never repeat hero text.
Flat JPG, baked play button, links to YouTube.
Reserve Your Visit + microcopy after video.
20+ years, 4.9 stars, 80% referrals, Lutron Certified.
Plain-language, 2 short paragraphs.
Crop to show architecture and light.
Numbered 01-04 steps.
Dusk/warm scene. Italic caption below.
Heading + offer/credit + Option A (orange) + Option B (ghost).
Premium room/project photo.
Specifier types with orange dot markers.
Closing statement + Reserve button + phone number.
Logo, social only.

htmlStructure: 600px max-width container, centered, background color on body.
All inline styles. No external stylesheets.
line-height:0 and font-size:0 on image container cells to kill ghost spacing.

verticalSpacing.stackedSameBackground: Reduce gaps 8-12px between stacked same-background sections

buttons.structure: Wrap in table > tr > td, not a div.
buttons.linkStates: Declare color on all 5 link pseudo-classes with !important.

inlineCtaCard.style: White card, border-radius:10px, inside cream/light section
inlineCtaCard.headline: Serif ~20px

images: width:100%; explicit heights for crop (object-fit/object-position unsupported in Outlook).
White-bordered images on white/cream sections only (dark exposes the border).
pillowHeroMethod: Directional dark gradient overlay (stronger left, lighter right) via RGBA compositing.
Render eyebrow/headline/subline/pill button with ImageDraw (DejaVu or Liberation fonts).
Save JPG at quality 92-93, upload to Zoho Campaigns image library.
Use the resulting stratus URL as a single linked ; the whole image is the clickable CTA.
zohoCampaigns: Zoho auto-appends compliance footer (sender info, address, unsubscribe, preferences, privacy, terms). Do not duplicate in HTML footer.
Custom HTML footer: Livewire logo + social links only.
CRM sync: Contacts > Sync Services > New Sync -> Leads module.
Email Opt-out toggle needs an Email Opt-out field on CRM Leads module; flag for Solomon if missing.
Test-send to self before deploying. Confirm images load and links active.
Public stratus URLs only generate when an image renders in a live campaign or preview send.

aboveTheFold: first content is hero image/headline (no spacer rows)
navigator block present for 2+ story newsletters
video: thumbnail links to correct YouTube URL
technical: Zoho tracking on phone if CallRail active

webUi.headlines: Fraunces display with font-variation-settings: "opsz" 144, "SOFT" 50; Montserrat body.

changelog.changes: Navigator block, cream body #F5EFE6, inline CTA cards, tightened vertical spacing, FAQ plain Q/A rule, no-emoji subject rule, Zoho footer clarification.
Technical production rules from Ketra build. Newsletter + Specifier blueprints. Pillow hero method, table-based structure.
Original research framework: subject lines, above the fold, CTAs, voice, benchmarks.
